body:
Problem: probeQuota (lib/pools.mjs) runs `agy -p /quota` and JSON.parses stdout expecting an invented {pools:[{name,fiveHour:{remainingPercent,resetTime},weekly:{...}}]} shape. Real agy 1.3.1 prints tab-separated text (`Gemini Models\tWeekly Limit Remaining\t98%\t<iso>`), so every probe fails and preflight/plan/review/brain/scheduler halt with 'quota telemetry unavailable from agy'. test/fixtures/fake-agy emits the same invented JSON, so the suite never saw the mismatch.

Fix: probeQuota passes `--output-format json`. Real 1.3.1 then prints one JSON object {status:'SUCCESS', command:{name:'usage', data:{groups:[{name:'Gemini Models'|'Claude and GPT models', buckets:[{id, window:'weekly'|'5h', remaining_fraction:0..1, reset_time:RFC3339 UTC}]}]}}}. parseQuotaProbeOutput accepts this envelope: requires status SUCCESS and command.data.groups array; requires exactly one bucket per window ('5h' -> fiveHour, 'weekly' -> weekly) per group (missing or duplicate window fails closed with quota_parse_failure); remaining_fraction must be a finite number in [0,1] (else invalid_quota_percentage) and is converted to percent (x100); reset_time goes through the existing strict RFC3339-UTC + future-ordering check. Group cardinality/name rules (exactly one 'Gemini Models' and one 'Claude and GPT models') stay as-is (ambiguous_quota_pools). The legacy internal pools shape stays accepted so existing tests keep pinning the validators. Raise the probe timeout from 10s to 30s (real call measured ~5s). fake-agy: without --output-format json emit the real TSV text; with it, emit the real envelope (captured from agy 1.3.1). Tests: parse the captured real envelope; TSV stdout is rejected; each new fail-closed branch; probeQuota passes the flag end-to-end through fake-agy. Rebuild dist. CHANGELOG Fixed entry. Acceptance: npm test green; real `agb` preflight quota probe succeeds against agy 1.3.1.
title: Quota probe parses the real agy 1.3.1 /quota output
